rule: Each entry maps an accepted input spelling to the canonical word in the list. Applied as an exact-match substitution before any fuzzy correction (spec §10.1). Encoders never emit a variant. Every target is a list word; no variant is. Additive; versioned with the overlay.

notes.meter: one edit from both 'metre' (its variant) and 'meteor' (a different list word); the table runs first so it resolves to 'metre'.
notes.donut, omelet, checker: two or more edits from their canonical words, beyond fuzzy correction; only the table resolves them.
